pages.text: Moves enchantments from an item onto books, one at a time, for experience levels.$(br2)Put the enchanted item in the first slot and plain $(item)Books$() in the second, then pick the enchantment to remove. It comes out as an enchanted book; the output slot must be empty.

Cost per enchantment level: 7 levels for one-level enchantments, 4 for those that max at II, and 3 for the rest. Sharpness V costs 15 levels.$(br2)Removing an enchantment also lowers the item's anvil repair cost.
